mapper.select: SELECT kb_id, tenant_id, kb_name, description, chunk_strategy, chunk_size, chunk_overlap, embedding_model, status, create_time FROM kb_knowledge_base WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} ORDER BY create_time DESC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO kb_knowledge_base (tenant_id, kb_name, description, chunk_strategy, chunk_size, chunk_overlap, embedding_model, status, create_time) VALUES (#{tenantId}, #{kbName}, #{description}, #{chunkStrategy}, #{chunkSize}, #{chunkOverlap}, #{embeddingModel}, #{status}, #{createTime})
mapper.update: UPDATE kb_knowledge_base SET kb_name = #{kbName}, description = #{description}, chunk_strategy = #{chunkStrategy}, chunk_size = #{chunkSize}, chunk_overlap = #{chunkOverlap}, embedding_model = #{embeddingModel}, status = #{status} WHERE kb_id = #{kbId}
UPDATE kb_knowledge_base SET status = #{status} WHERE kb_id = #{kbId}
